name: Luma
summary: Event platform for creating, hosting and discovering events: invites, ticketing, reminders, check-in and public discovery.
description: Luma is a hosted event platform: create an event or calendar, send invites and automated reminders by email, SMS, push notification or WhatsApp, sell tickets with cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay and regional methods, check guests in, and publish events to a discovery feed and mobile app. The free plan has unlimited events and guests with a 5% platform fee on paid events; Luma Plus ($59/month billed annually) drops the fee to 0%, raises sends to 5,000/week and adds taxes, custom URLs, Zapier and API access.
contains: free plan: unlimited events and guests, 5% platform fee for paid events
Luma Plus: $59/month billed annually, 0% platform fee, 5,000 sends/week, taxes, Zapier, API access
invites and reminders by email, SMS, push notification and WhatsApp
ticketing: cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, iDEAL, Konbini, PayNow; ticket types, group purchasing, coupons
check-in, cohosts, calendar admins, approval or token gating, CSV import/export, Zoom integration
add-on sends: 10,000 for $50/mo up to 100,000 for $800/mo
